title: Informed re-plan — the plan learns from failure (three stages)
spec: Implementation Plan/PHASE_10D_informed_replan.md v1.0.0 (owner-approved plan 2026-10-12 via ExitPlanMode; three stages, one verifier+emulator loop each)
owner_decisions_2026-10-12: verified subtasks immutable by default; EXACTLY ONE declared step back allowed (the last verified subtask may be rewritten when the path itself was wrong)
a rollback must be declared with its lesson (the ladder JSON `rollback` object {steps, lesson}); missing/blank while the prefix diverges = refused loudly
growth allowed: the failing subtask may split into smaller intermediate subtasks (still <= 8)
cheap in-page recovery first (handshake assist -> one bounded stage-1 re-ask -> fallback), then the informed re-plan at the SAME cap (2 re-plans, card at 3 consecutive failures)
all three workstreams (informed re-plan / evidence fix / field legibility) in SEPARATE stages; the owner UAT only after all three
GENERALITY LAW: no site-specific logic anywhere — Wikipedia/BBC/Google/allrecipes are instances, not targets

process: orchestrator implements (glm-5.3-flash implementer over budget) -> canon-verifier cold -> fix -> re-verify -> orchestrator emulator app-verification (@Android-Dev) -> fix -> re-verify; stages run autonomously; UAT handover only at the end

defects.D4: all-empty editable controls enumerate with a BLANK label (Test 1 [n32] "" tap edit) — the search-box wall
defects.D5: the failure cause is dropped on the card path (NavigationLoop.kt:1070 stuckCause = null)
